frequency_semantics: A new discrete control command is generated and executed once at each control update. No repeated environment action is applied between updates.

experiment_interpretation.noise: Action corruption affecting control accuracy, trajectory and reward.
experiment_interpretation.frequency: Physiological/control command update rate affecting response latency and completion time in the discrete model.
experiment_interpretation.interaction: Noise can increase the number of decisions required. Lower control frequency increases the time cost of those additional decisions.
experiment_interpretation.future_extension: Continuous dynamics can model persistent linear and angular motion between control updates.
